text:
QUOTE: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`library/memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`) is a built-in heap: It zeroes a static `heap` context and calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` with `buffer_alloc_calloc_mutexed`/`buffer_alloc_free_mutexed` when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on, or the unmutexed pair otherwise.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init calls the setter, but it never names MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C or says it is the only in-tree user of the setter. It also says "benchmark.c and the library's own self-test use it", which suggests other users.
